snippet.title: Agent Sirius - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/agent-sirius/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3517070/Agent_Sirius/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

Join Beni Akesuzu, the high school detective president and secret agent, in this thrilling mystery RPG! Investigate mysterious incidents, solve puzzles, and uncover a sinister plot as monsters lurk in the shadows in a race to save the school and it's students before it’s too late!
